primaryComponents: Removable water tank with integrated water filter holder
Removable bean hopper with grind size adjustment mechanism
Dual stainless steel boilers (one espresso, one steam)
3-way solenoid valve (for brew group pressure release)
Automated steam wand with integrated temperature sensor
Touchscreen display (LCD/OLED with capacitive touch layer)
operationalLogic: The Breville Oracle Touch operates by processing whole coffee beans into espresso and automatically texturing milk. Upon user selection from the touchscreen, the integrated conical burr grinder precisely grinds beans into the 58mm portafilter basket. An automated tamping mechanism then compresses the grounds. Simultaneously, PID-controlled dual boilers heat water to optimal temperatures for brewing and steaming. The 15-bar pump forces hot water through the coffee puck, initiating pre-infusion followed by extraction. Concurrently, the automated steam wand heats and textures milk to user-defined settings using its internal sensor and purges itself post-use. The entire process is managed by a central microcontroller coordinating grind, dose, tamp, brew temperature, pressure, and steam functions.
maintenanceNodes: Grinder burr cleaning and eventual replacement
Group head gasket inspection and replacement
Steam wand tip cleaning and unclogging
Descaling of internal boilers and water paths
